verdict: Leads are up and cost is down, but Google spend needs fixing now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 138 leads at a cost of $15.83 per lead, entirely through Meta — and the most recent 7 days show momentum building, with lead volume up 8.33% and cost per lead down 1.08% week-over-week. Google Ads ran $507 in spend this period and returned zero leads or conversions, which is a confirmed spend leak we are actively addressing. In parallel, 130 leads entered your pipeline over the 28 days but zero converted to appointments or closed opportunities, pointing to a follow-up gap that is under review. Several build milestones — including landing pages and CRM setup — are overdue, and completing these is the unlock for scaling; work on each is in motion with a target of end of September.
